verification_report.summary:
The complete standalone proposition, class-closure corollary, and final scope paragraph pass sequential verification relative to the expressly accepted prerequisites. Sixteen statement checks and four reference checks found no critical errors or gaps. The book was read only.

Normalization preserves the measures and class: replacing u_j by u_j-t changes A to A exp(lambda t), while subtracting sup psi_j places each reference in [-2L,0]. The standing model hypothesis supplies a fixed genuine q=P_{epsilon theta}(phi), with 0<epsilon<1; bigness supplies genuine rho with theta_rho>=a omega. No analytic singularities are required.

For every real b>=1, stretch closure gives genuine r_{j,b} in E_phi with r_{j,b}<=u_j<=0. Contact support, the pure mixed-product coefficient b^(-n), and ordered contact give mu_r<=b^n 1_D mu_u_j. On D, u_j=r/b+(1-1/b)phi<=r/b, proving exp(-lambda r/b)mu_r<=b^n A omega_psi_j^n. Uniform bounded-reference masses and exp(-lambda r/b)>=1 therefore prove finite mu_r, uniformly in j for each fixed b, without BMP.

One valid choice is C_b=(b/lambda)max{0,log(b^n A/delta^n)}. For s=q+(1-epsilon)rho+delta psi_j-C_b, subtracting delta omega_psi_j from theta_s leaves (epsilon theta+ddc q)+(1-epsilon)(theta_rho-a omega)+((1-epsilon)a-delta)omega, which is positive. Thus s is genuine theta-psh. Positive products on finite local levels give mu_s>=delta^n omega_psi_j^n; exhaustion is valid because the bounded reference measure ignores the poles. Also s<=phi-C_b and s<=-C_b. These facts give exactly exp(-lambda s/b)mu_s>=b^n A omega_psi_j^n>=exp(-lambda r/b)mu_r. Finite mass of s is never assumed.

In the PVP branch, relative exponential comparison applies with first potential r, whose class membership and finite measure were proved, and second potential s preceq phi. In the ordinary-type branch, phi-bK_j is a competitor, so phi-bK_j<=r<=phi. The potential q-bK_j supplies a genuine smaller-background envelope of r, and s<=r+bK_j supplies the required singularity order. Singular exponential comparison therefore gives r>=s without PVP. Both comparisons use exponent lambda/b>0. The possibly unbounded constants K_j never enter the common barrier.

The resulting H_b=q+(1-epsilon)rho-2delta L-C_b is genuine theta-psh and lies below every r_{j,b}. At b=1 it prevents collapse of h=P_theta(inf_j u_j). For each real b>=1, H_b/b+(1-1/b)phi is a competitor for h; consequently H_b belongs to the exact defining competitor family A_b(h,phi). Together with h<=phi, this proves full E_phi membership. No limit in b or bound uniform in b is needed. Translation restores the original normalization.

For the corollary, an almost-everywhere convergent subsequence and canonical representatives give h<=u<=phi+C; upward stability proves u in E_phi. The final attribution matches the envelope conclusion of [ALS26 v1, Lemma 4.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.02339v1), verified after theorem search and web fallback. That source includes convergence hypotheses which this independently proved envelope result does not need. Neither capacity convergence, limiting-measure identification, ordinary type of h, nor finite mass of h is inferred.
